I can't confirm that for the full period. Zero detections intersected ASSET-F14 between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-12, but coverage was incomplete under the run's own rule, which requires every sensor to cover every day.

- VIIRS NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS covered the whole period.
- VIIRS S-NPP has a gap from 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-06 because FIRMS did not make that data available for those days.

So the accurate statement is: no detections were found in the data that was available. Because of the S-NPP gap, the full period doesn't meet the coverage standard. The other three sensors did cover those days and showed nothing, which is reassuring but not equivalent to complete coverage. To close the gap, rerun the check once S-NPP data for 2–6 November becomes available.
